name: Tamura Hina
source: Daughter of Chihaya. She loves her mother and the protagonist because he always takes care of her. Because her father neglects her and the family, she wishes the protagonist could be her father instead.
translation: Daughter of Chihaya. She loves her mother and the protagonist because he always takes care of her. Because her father neglects her and the family, she wishes the protagonist could be her father instead.
